channel.title: Nature Communications
channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [6] Mesoscale ordered assembly of Er3+-doped quantum dots enables efficient 1.55 µm electroluminescence
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Ya-Kun Wang, Liang-Sheng Liao

Authors: Hua-Hui Li, Jia-Lin Pan, Ying-Ying Pan, et al.

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Materials science on perovskite quantum dots for light sources, relevant to applied CM/photonics.

Tags: #materialsscience #quantumdots #perovskite #photonics

Abstract: Efficient 1.55 micrometer light sources are needed for telecom and infrared photonics, but realizing them with perovskite quantum dots is challenging due to bandgap limitations. Li et al. used Er3 + -doping and hydrogen-bonded ordered assembly in CsPbCl3 to enable efficient electroluminescence.
